objective: Define one pure mature-cohort conversion-window boundary that restricts acquisition economics and durable outcome evidence to each relationship's complete N-day elapsed UTC observation window.

semantics.denominator: only relationships whose complete N-day window has elapsed by asOfExclusive
semantics.effectiveAt: metadata only; never controls conversion-window inclusion

rules: asOfExclusive and relationship createdAt values must be canonical UTC timestamps in ISO-8601 millisecond Z form.
windowDays must be a positive safe integer.
N days means elapsed UTC duration, not local calendar-day arithmetic.
Relationship identities are canonically validated and deduplicated preserving first occurrence order.
Duplicate relationship identities with conflicting createdAt values are rejected.
A relationship is mature when its windowEndExclusive is less than or equal to asOfExclusive.
Immature relationships are excluded from the fixed-window denominator rather than treated as partially observed nonconversions.
Every economics and durable outcome fact must belong to the supplied relationship cohort.
Evidence for immature relationships is excluded.
Evidence for mature relationships is included only when occurredAt is earlier than both asOfExclusive and that relationship's windowEndExclusive.
Facts occurring exactly at the relationship window end are excluded.
Raw fact order and object identity are preserved.
No lower-bound occurredAt rule is introduced in this slice.
INS-004K remains unchanged as the global fixed-cutoff owner.

No presentation reconstruction, aggregation, rate calculation, division, currency conversion, SQL, persistence access, mutation, schema change, migration execution, dashboard UI, deployment, or telephony activation occurs in this layer.
